home.cardExpensesInfoBody1: Yonke into ehlawuliswayo kumakhadi akho etyala kule nyanga - swayipha, ukuthengwa kwe-intanethi, intlawulo ye-UPI eyenziwe ekhadini. Ukubona nganye nganye, vula Iindleko kwaye ukhethe isihluzo seKhadi.
home.cardExpensesInfoBody2: Inkcitho yekhadi ayidityaniswa kwiindleko zebhanki ngasentla. Loo mali ayikaphumi kwibhanki yakho okwangoku; iyahamba xa uhlawula ityala.
home.billPaidInfoBody1: Imali efikelele kumakhadi akho okuthenga ngetyala kule nyanga kwaye yagqiba oko ubusele uyichithile kuwo. Ukubona intlawulo nganye, vula uMvuzo kwaye ukhethe isihluzo seKhadi.
home.billPaidInfoBody2: Ityala elihlawulwe ngqo kwibhanki yakho likwabalwa kwiindleko zebhanki, kuba loo mali iphumile kwiakhawunti yakho. Ayikhe yongezwe kwiindleko zekhadi - ezo nkcitho zibalwe ngosuku ozenzileyo.
home.billPaidInfoBody3: Ihlawulwe ngezinye ii-apps? Imali efike ekhadini iboniswa apha, ngelixa idebhithi ebiyixhasile ihlala kwiindleko zebhanki phantsi kwegama lalo app, ngoko ke akukho nto ibalwa kabini.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody1: Yonke into eshiye ii-akhawunti zakho zebhanki kunye nemali ezinkozo kule nyanga: I-UPI neentlawulo zasimahla zekhadi, iitshekhi, ukutsalwa kwemali kwi-ATM, imiyalelo emileyo, nayo nantoni na oyongeze ngesandla. Nganye ibala ngomhla wayo, kwaye ukucofa ithayile kuzidwelisa zonke.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody2: Inkcitho yekhadi letyala ayibalwa apha. Yelekhadi ude ube uyilungisile, ke ihleli kumqolo wekhadi letyala apha ngezantsi endaweni yoko - imali isekwiakhawunti yakho.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody3: Ityala lekhadi letyala elihlawulwe kwibhanki yakho libalwa apha, mhla yaphuma kwiakhawunti. Elo lixesha inkcitho yekhadi ekugqibeleni ifikelele kwibhanki yakho, kwaye ibalwe kube kanye kuphela: njengenkcitho yebhanki, ayisayi kuphinda ibe yinkcitho yekhadi.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody4: Ukuhambisa imali kwenye yeeakhawunti zakho nako kuyabala, kuba iyishiyile le. Iakhawunti eyifumeneyo irekhoda ingeniso efanayo, ngoko ke ibhalansi yakho ayitshintshanga.
home.bankExpensesInfoBody5: Iiakhawunti oziphawule njengezikhutshiweyo zishiywa ngaphandle ngokupheleleyo, kwaye kukwanjalo nayo nayiphi na into ebhalwe ngaphandle kwale nyanga.
home.sumBankExpensesNote: Kungenxa yoko le nto inani linokubukeka likhulu kwinyanga ohlawule ngayo ibhilikhwe: i-bill yimali ephuma ebhankini, nangona uyisebenzise ngaphambili.
home.sumEverythingSpentNote: Ityala olihlawuleyo lihlala ngaphakathi kumgca wokuqala, okoko laa mali ishiye ibhanki yakho kule nyanga. Ikhadi elilichithayo libalwe kwikhadi ngenyanga olenzileyo, ngoko ke intlawulo yenkcitho endala ibalwa kule nyanga nakule.
home.bankIncomeInfoBody1: Yonke into efikileyo kwibhanki yakho kunye neeakhawunti zemali kule nyanga: umvuzo, inzala, iimbuyiselo, imali efunyenwe nge-UPI, nayo nantoni na oyongeze ngesandla. Cofa ithayile ukuze ubone nganye.
home.bankIncomeInfoBody2: Imali engenisiweyo isuka kwenye iakhawunti yakho iyabalwa, kuba le akhawunti iye yayifumana. I-akhawunti ephuma kuyo ithwala iindleko ezihambelanayo.
home.bankIncomeInfoBody3: Intlawulo efikelela kwikhadi lakho letyala ayiyongeniso. Iyacima into oyityalayo ekhadini, ngoko ke kubonakala ngathi iBhili ihlawulwe kuluhlu lwekhadi letyala elingezantsi.
home.sumBalanceNote: Okushiye ii-akhawunti zakho kubandakanya i-bill yekhadi letyala olihlawule kule nyanga, yiyo loo nto inyanga ene-bill inokuphuma iphantsi kunokuba ivakalelwa.
home.bankBalanceInfoBody1: Umvuzo webhanki wale nyanga uthatyathwe kwiindleko zebhanki zale nyanga. Akukho nto yimbi ikuyo, ngoko ke amanani amabini asecaleni kwayo ahlala eyongeza kweli.
home.bankBalanceInfoBody2: Ayiyiyo le mali uyiphetheyo namhlanje. Nokuba yeyiphi na iakhawunti efakwe kwiinyanga ezingaphambili ayiyonxalenye yayo - vula iiAkhawunti ukuze ubone ezo ziphelele zibalekayo.
home.bankBalanceInfoBody3: Inani elingaphantsi kuka-zero lithetha ngokulula ngakumbi okushiye ii-akhawunti zakho kule nyanga kunokufika, nto leyo eyenzeka rhoqo xa intlawulo yekhadi letyala lenkcitho yangaphambili ingena kuyo.

Ngenisa uhlaziyo lwentengiselwano kunye nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali kuphela kuluhlu lomhla kwifayile. Idatha engaphandle koluhlu kule fowuni ihlala. 

Iiakhawunti: zibuyiselwa kwifayile kuphela ukuba le fowuni ayinazo zezentengiselwano okwangoku (umzekelo emva kokufakwa kwakhona). Kungenjalo iiakhawunti zakho zangoku zihlala.

alarms.enableInfo:
I-master switch yezikhumbuzo. Ngayo, isikhumbuzi sifika njengesaziso sefowuni ngexesha laso, nokuba iMoneyLit ivuliwe okanye ayivulwanga, kwaye ivula i-app nge-Kwenziwe kwaye Snuza xa uyicofa.

Ngaphandle kwayo, akukho nto ifikayo.

Sebenzisa ezi zitshintshi zimbini zingezantsi ukugqiba ukuba ngaba izikhumbuzo zenza isandi nokuba ziyangcangcazela. Isaziso ngokwaso sihlala sivela.

legal.searchNone: Akukho sihloko sikhankanyiweyo "{q}". Zama igama elifutshane.
faq.intro: Impendulo emfutshane ethi "ndiyenza njani loo nto?", ngeetephu ezibhalwe ngaphandle. Cofa umbuzo ukuze uwuvule, okanye ukhangele igama elifana nomxholo, ibhajethi okanye ucime.
faq.aAddTxn:
Iqhosha elingu-+ embindini webha engezantsi livula yongeza iNtengiselwano naphi na kwi-app. Khetha Iindleko okanye uMvuzo, cofa udidi olukulo, uze ufake imali kunye nomhla.

Ihlawulwe nge / Ifunyenwe kwiscreen esinye sithatha isigqibo sokuba yeyiphi iakhawunti imali eshiya okanye ingena kuyo, ke khetha echanekileyo ukuba ugcina ngaphezu kweakhawunti enye. Kufuneka ungene ukuze ugcine.
faq.qCardTxn: Ndiyibhala njani inkcitho yekhadi letyala okanye intlawulo yetyala letyala?
faq.aCardTxn:
Ikhadi letyala kwithebhu Yongeza iNtengiselwano ibonakala xa une-akhawunti yekhadi letyala. Ibonelela ngezinto ezimbini: inkcitho yekhadi letyala ngento oyithengileyo ekhadini, kunye netyala lekhadi letyala ngentlawulo oyenza kwinkampani yekhadi.

Ukuzahlula kubalulekile. I-bill yekhadi ithathwa njengemali esuka ebhankini yakho ukuya kwikhadi, kungekhona njengeendleko zesibini, ngoko ke ukuhlawula ityala alibali inkcitho efanayo kabini.
faq.aEditTxn:
Vula uludwe lwentengiselwano olusuka kumqolo othi Phonononga kwiscreen sokuqala — ukucofa Iindleko okanye iNgeniso iyonke apho kukuthatha kuluhlu olufanayo. Cofa intengiselwano ukuvula iinkcukacha zayo, emva koko Hlela, utshintshe into engalunganga, kwaye Hlaziya.

Ungatshintsha inani, udidi, umhla, inqaku kunye neakhawunti. Uluhlu lubonisa kuphela inyanga oyikhethileyo, ngoko ke yiya kuloo nyanga kuqala ukuba intengiselwano indala.
faq.aDeleteTxn:
Cofa itransekshini kuluhlu ukuze uvule iinkcukacha zayo, emva koko Cima. Ikucela ukuba uqinisekise kuqala, kuba intengiselwano ecinyiweyo ayinakubuyiswa.

Ukucima intlawulo yetyala lekhadi kususa amacala omabini ngaxeshanye, ngoko ke ibhanki kunye nekhadi zombini zibuyela kwinto ebeziyiyo.
faq.aDeleteMany:
Lonke utshintshiselwano luluhlu kuphela oluneebhokisi zokuphawula. Cofa umqolo ngamnye owufunayo, okanye sebenzisa Khetha konke kuyo yonke into ebonisiweyo ngoku, emva koko Cima kwaye uqinisekise. Ibha engezantsi igcina ubalo lwento oyikhethileyo.

Seta unyaka, inyanga kunye nezihluzi zemini phezulu kuqala - yeyona ndlela ikhawulezayo yokucima inyanga enye, kwaye igcina Khetha konke ekuthatheni iintengiselwano obufuna ukuzigcina.
faq.aTheme:
Imixholo idwelisa yonke isethi yombala, kwaye ukucofa enye kuyisebenzisa kuyo yonke indawo ngokukhawuleza - akukho kuphinda kuqalwe, kwaye akukho nto itshintshileyo.

Imixholo embalwa iphawulelwe iNtlawulo yaNyanga le. Ukuba awubhalisi, unokuvula enye ngedayimani kwiscreen seDayimane endaweni yoko.
faq.qAvatar: Ndiwutshintsha njani umfanekiso wam okanye ndikhethe umlinganiswa?
faq.aAvatar:
Umfanekiso wakho uhlala kwiProfayile yam. Thepha, emva koko ukhethe iClassic-isiqalo sakho kumbala womxholo-okanye omnye wabalinganiswa be-3D.

Abalinganiswa yiPremium eyongezelelweyo, kwaye ingavulwa ngedayimani kangangenani eliqingqiweyo leentsuku. Isikrini seDayimane sibonisa iindleko kunye nexesha elide lokuvula.
faq.aAppLock:
Isitshixo sosetyenziso sisebenzisa umnwe, ubuso okanye isitshixo sesikrini ifowuni esele inayo, ke akukho gama liyimfihlo lokukhumbula kwaye akukho nto igciniweyo eyongezelelweyo. Ukuyivula kukucela ukuba uqinisekise kube kanye, ukuze uqiniseke ukuba iyasebenza.

Emva koko i-app ibuza ukuba uyivula nini, kwaye kwakhona xa ubuyela kuyo emva kwexesha - hayi lonke ixesha ujonga kwisaziso. Ukuba kamva ususa isitshixo sesikrini kwifowuni, i-app iyayeka ukubuza kunokukuvalela ngaphandle kweerekhodi zakho.
faq.aLanguage:
Ulwimi ludwelisa lonke ulwimi iapp efumaneka ngalo. Cofa enye kwaye yonke iapp itshintshe ngoko nangoko, kuquka le FAQ.

Amagama asemthethweni kwiMigqaliselo yokuSetyenziswa kunye noMgaqo-nkqubo waBucala ahlala esiNgesini, njengoko iyinguqulelo esebenzayo ngokusemthethweni. Yonke enye into iguqulelwe.
faq.qImportSms: Ndiyijika njani iSMS yebhanki yam ibeyintengiselwano?
faq.aImportSms:
Iintengiselwano ezivela kwamanye amazwe zifunda imiyalezo yebhanki esele ikule fowuni kwinyanga oyikhethileyo, kwaye idwelise oko ikubone njengeendleko, umvuzo kunye neentlawulo zetyala lekhadi. Phawula kwezo uzifunayo, lungisa naluphi na udidi, uze Faka iitransekshini.

Umbhalo weSMS uhlala kule fowuni. Ukuba ugcina ungeniso kunye nongqamaniso lwamafu lwePremium luvuliwe, ezo rekhodi zigciniweyo zinokugcinwa efini. Nantoni na esele ingenisiwe iphawulwe ngoko ke awukwazi ukuyidibanisa kabini. Ukufunda iSMS yi-Android kuphela — iApple ayivumeli nayiphi na iapp ukuba iyenze.
faq.qAutoImport: Ngaba i-SMS yebhanki ingongezwa ngaphandle kokuba ndiwangenise rhoqo?
faq.aAutoImport:
Ewe. Vula Yongeza ngokuzenzekelayo kwiscreen sentengiselwano kunye nemiyalezo ehambelanayo iba yintengiselwano ngokwalo lonke ixesha uvula usetyenziso.

Icinyiwe de uyivule, idinga ukufikelela kweSMS ukuba ivunyelwe, kwaye isebenza kuphela ngelixa i-app ivuliwe. Isikrini esifanayo sisadwelisa yonke into, ukuze ujonge ukuba yongeze ntoni kwaye ucime nantoni na obungayifuni.
faq.qAddAccount: Ndiyongeza njani iakhawunti yebhanki okanye ikhadi letyala?
faq.aAddAccount:
Iiakhawunti zibamba yonke indawo imali yakho ihleli. Sebenzisa + Yongeza iakhawunti, uyinike igama, faka into ekuyo namhlanje njengebhalansi yokuqala, kwaye ukhethe uhlobo - IBhanki / Ikheshi / Ikhadi leDebhithi, okanye iKhadi leTyala.

Uhlobo lulo olugcina inkcitho yekhadi ngaphandle kwebhalansi yakho yebhanki, ke ikhadi letyala kufuneka longezwe njengeKhadi leThredithi hayi njengeakhawunti yebhanki.
faq.qEditAccount: Ndiyinika ngokutsha okanye ndiyicime njani iakhawunti?
faq.aEditAccount:
Ikhadi ngalinye le-akhawunti kwi-Akhawunti yesikrini linoHlelo lwegama, ukuqala ibhalansi kunye nohlobo, kunye noCima kwi-akhawunti ngokwayo.

I-akhawunti yebhanki enye kunye nekhadi lekhredithi lihlala lihlala, nokuba ubize nantoni na, ngoko ke yokugqibela nganye ayinakucinywa. Yongeza utshintshiselwano kuqala kwaye endala inokuhamba.
faq.qCategory: Ndilongeza okanye ndiluthiye njani ngokutsha udidi?
faq.aCategory:
Iindidi zinethebhu yeeNdleko kunye nenye yeNgeniso. Cofa kulo naliphi na icandelo ukuze ulinike igama ngokutsha okanye utshintshe i-icon kunye nombala walo, okanye usebenzise + Yongeza udidi lweendleko ezantsi ukuze ufumane entsha.

Ukuthiya ngokutsha kuthwala iintengiselwano ezindala kunye nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwayo, ngoko ke akukho nto iyinkedama. Ukucima udidi kuhambisa nantoni na ebisetyenzisiwe kwabanye, kwaye Okunye ngokwako akunakucinywa.
faq.aBudget:
Ithebhu yoHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali kulapho imida ihlala khona. Cofa ISETHA IBHAJETHI, khetha udidi, faka isixa kwaye ugcine. Uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali ngalunye lubonisa uluhlu lwemali oyichithile kule nyanga.

I ⋮ kwikhadi lohlahlo lwabiwo-mali likuvumela ukuba ulihlele okanye ulisuse, kwaye ikopi yenyanga edlulileyo izisa imida yenyanga ephelileyo ngaphambili endaweni yokuba uyichwetheze kwakhona.
faq.aReminder:
Vula izikhumbuzi kumqolo ongentla kweethebhu kwaye ukhethe uhlobo olufunayo: izikhumbuzo zetyala okanye iindleko, amayeza, imihla yokuphelelwa kwegrosari, okanye inqaku jikelele. Nganye inethebhu entsha apho ugcwalisa khona iinkcukacha kwaye ugcine.

Izikhumbuzi zifika njengezaziso zefowuni, ukuze zifike kuwe ngosetyenziso oluvaliweyo. Oko kufuna imvume yesaziso, esicelwa yi-app kube kanye, kwaye iifowuni ezilawula ibhetri ngamandla zisenokuthi zibambe isilumkiso. Nokuba izikhumbuzo zenza isandi okanye zingcangcazele kuxhomekeke kuwe kwiiAlarms kunye nezaziso.
faq.aBuyList:
Thenga uluhlu, kumqolo ongentla kweethebhu, zizinto oceba ukuzithenga. Chwetheza into kunye nobungakanani, wongeze, kwaye uphawule nganye evenkileni.

Ihlala kuluhlu lodwa: ukukorekisha into akudali ndleko, kwaye ayithumeli nantoni na kwizikhumbuzi.
faq.aSplit:
Ukwahlula, kumqolo ongentla kweethebhu, kugcina inkcitho ekwabelwana ngayo. Yongeza abahlobo okanye iqela kuqala, emva koko wongeze iindleko kwindawo ethi Iindleko, khetha owabelana ngayo, kwaye wonge. Ibhalansi ibonisa ukuba ngubani na onetyala emva kokuba yonke into ibalwe.

I-Split luphawu lwePrimiyamu, ke ikucela ukuba ubone izicwangciso ukuba iakhawunti yakho ayinayo.
faq.qCharts: Ndiyibona phi imali yam apho yaya khona?
faq.aCharts:
Ithebhu yeetshathi yaphula inyanga ekhethiweyo ngokwecandelo njengeringi, kwaye ingabonisa umvuzo endaweni yeendleko. Guqula unyaka, inyanga okanye usuku phezulu ukujonga elinye ixesha.

Ithebhu yoHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali iphendula esinye isiqingatha sayo - into obucwangcise ukuyichitha ngokuchasene noko ukuchithileyo.
faq.aBackup:
Idatha yokugcina ibhala yonke into - ukuthengiselana, ii-akhawunti, uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, izikhumbuzo kunye noluhlu lokuthenga - kwifayile enye ongayithumela kuwe okanye uyigcine kwisitoreji samafu.

Yenza oku ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe iifowuni okanye ubuyisele usetyenziso. Ugcino luphawu lwePrimiyamu. Thumela iData yinto eyahlukileyo: i-spreadsheet yokufunda, kungekhona ifayile onokuyibuyisela kuyo.
faq.qRestore: Ndiyifumana njani idatha yam kwifowuni entsha?
faq.aRestore:
Faka usetyenziso, ungene ngeakhawunti enye, emva koko usebenzise uBuyisela ugcino kwaye ukhethe ifayile oyigcinileyo.

Ukubuyisela endaweni yento ekwi-app ngoku, iyakulumkisa ngaphambi kokuba iqhubeke. Ukuba ubunePremium ngongqamaniso lwamafu, idatha yakho ibuya xa ungena ngaphandle kwefayile kwaphela.
faq.aSignIn:
Ukungena kuGoogle kuko okuvumela iapp igcine nantoni na. Ngaphandle kwayo ungajonga ngapha nangapha, kodwa ukongeza kunye nokuhlela kuvaliwe, kwaye akukho nto igcinwayo.

Kwakhona idibanisa idatha yakho kuwe kunokuba ifowuni, ngoko ifowuni elahlekileyo ayithethi ukuba iirekhodi ezilahlekileyo.
faq.aSignOut:
Phuma uhlala ezantsi kwesikrini seProfayili kwaye ikucela ukuba uqinisekise.

Ukuphuma akucimi nto. Sayina nge-akhawunti efanayo kwaye idatha yakho ikhona kwakhona. Ukususa idatha yakho endaweni yoko, sebenzisa Cima yonke idatha kwiisetingi ze-App.
faq.aPremium:
ILungu lePremium kwiProfayili yesikrini ivula uthelekiso, oludwelisa yonke into kwaye luphawule oko kusimahla kunye noko kufuna isicwangciso. Ngamafutshane: ukuvumelanisa ilifu, ukugcina iifayile kunye nokubuyisela, iindleko zokwahlula, ii-Smart Insights, yonke imixholo kunye nee-avatar zomlinganiswa, kwaye akukho ntengiso.

Yonke into enokuyenza ngokulandelela imali imihla ngemihla - ukuthengiselana, ii-akhawunti, uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, iitshathi, izikhumbuzo, uluhlu lokuthenga kunye nokungenisa kwe-SMS - ikhululekile.
faq.aDiamonds:
Iidayimani zifunyanwa ngokubukela ividiyo emfutshane, ukuya kuthi ga kwimini embalwa, kwaye ichithwa kwiscreen seDayimane ukuvula izinto ngaphandle kokuhlawula: umxholo, i-avatar yomlinganiswa, okanye ipasile etshintsha iiPrimiyamu kwiinombolo ezimiselweyo zeentsuku.

Ukudlula kwedayimani akuzisusi iintengiso - iintengiso zizo ezifumana iidayimani. Ukumema umhlobo nako kunomvuzo.
faq.qHomeMonth: Kutheni iitotali zenyanga ze-app zingahambelani nebhalansi yam yebhanki?
faq.aHomeMonth:
Isikrini sokuqala yingxelo yenyanga ojonge kuyo: Iindleko kunye neNgeniso zitotali zaloo nyanga, kwaye ibhalansi yenye thabatha enye. Asiyomali onayo.

Eyona nto uyibambileyo ikwi-Akhawunti yesikrini, ebalwa nyanga zonke kunye nebhalansi yokuqala yeakhawunti nganye. Umqolo wekhadi letyala usebenza ngendlela efanayo - into echithwe kwikhadi kule nyanga, kwaye yintoni ehlawulwe kuyo.
faq.qContact: Ndiyixela njani ingxaki okanye ndicele into?
faq.aContact:
Ingxelo kwiisetingi ze-App ithumela umyalezo ngqo kuthi, kwaye isikrini sokuqala sineNgxelo yomcimbi kwaye Cela inqaku lale nto inye.

Ukutsho ukuba usiphi isikrini kwaye ubulindele ntoni endaweni yoko kwenza ingxaki ngokukhawuleza ukuyifumana. Uncedo kunye neMigqaliselo yokuSebenzisa igubungela indlela inxalenye nganye ye-app yenzelwe ukusebenza ngayo.

terms.guide3Body:
La macandelo angezantsi ahamba kuwo onke amanqaku ngendlela onokuthi uhlangabezane nayo, ukusuka kwisikrini saseKhaya ukuya kwiakhawunti yakho kunye nedatha. Nganye ichaza into eyenziwa licandelo kunye nendlela eliziphatha ngayo, ukuze wazi into ovuma ukuyisebenzisa.

Ezinye iifitsha zinokucinywa, kuxatyiswe ngokwahlukileyo, okanye zikhutshwe kancinci kancinci ngumshicileli, ngoko ke into oyibonayo kwi-App isoloko iligama lokugqibela. Amaxabiso kunye namaxabiso anikwe apha ayimiyo kwaye angatshintsha.
terms.guide31Body:
Ibhendi ephezulu yeKhaya ibonisa iiNdleko, uMvuzo kunye neNgxowa-mali yenyanga yangoku yekhalenda. Ukucofa Iindleko okanye uMvuzo kuvula uluhlu oluhambelanayo.

Xa unekhadi letyala, umqolo wesibini uhlala ngaphantsi unamanani amabini enyanga: into oyibize kumakhadi akho, kunye nento oyihlawule kumatyala abo. Ityala lekhadi olihlawuleyo likwabalwa njengemali ephuma kwi-akhawunti oyihlawuleyo, ngoko ke le miqolo mibini idibanisa yonke into oyisebenzisileyo.

Ungayifihla ibhendi yesishwankathelo, ukhethe ukuba iKhaya liyavula kwiiNdleko okanye uMvuzo, kwaye usete indlela intengiselwano ihlelwa ngayo, kwiiSetingi ze-App phantsi kwekhasi laseKhaya.
terms.guide32Body:
Iqhosha elingu-+ livula ifomu yokongeza. Khetha iNcitho, uMvuzo okanye ikhadi leTyala, khetha udidi, emva koko ufake imali, i-akhawunti ephuma kuyo okanye eyile kuyo, umhla, kunye nenqaku lokuzikhethela.

Ungaqhoboshela ifoto yetyala kwintengiselwano. Ungeniso lwegrosari lunokwahlulwa lube yinto nganye enemihla yokuphelelwa kwayo, nto leyo enokukunyusela izikhumbuzo zegrosari ngokuzenzekelayo.

Nayiphi na intengiselwano inokuhlelwa okanye icinywe kamva ngokuyicofa kuluhlu.
terms.guide33Body:
Ikhadi letyala aliyiyo imbiza yemali, ngoko i-App iyigcina ihluke kwii-akhawunti ezigcina imali yokwenene. Into oyibizayo ekhadini yinkcitho ekwikhadi, kwaye “ityala letyala letyala” iirekhodi ezihlawula ikhadi njengemali egqithiselwayo esuka kwiakhawunti ebiyihlawule ekhadini.

I-bill ibalwa njengemali ephuma kwi-akhawunti yokuhlawula, ngelixa umntu echitha ukuhlala ebalwa kwikhadi, ngoko ke imali efanayo ayibalwa kabini. Ikhaya kunye nesishwankathelo seNtengiselwano sibonisa amanani omabini enyanga: ahlawuliswe kwikhadi, kwaye ahlawulwe kulo.

I-App ayilandeleli umda wakho wetyala okanye igumbi lentloko elishiywe kuyo. Yibhanki yakho kuphela ewaziyo umda kwaye ichitha isitatimenti esigqunyiweyo, ngoko ke naliphi na inani le-App esetyenzisiweyo kwimiyalezo yakho lilodwa linokuba lingalunganga. Jonga isitatimenti sekhadi lakho ukuze ubone umda okhoyo kuwe.
terms.guide34Body:
Iiakhawunti kulapho imali yakho ihlala khona. Kukho iindidi ezimbini: i-akhawunti yemali, eboniswa njengeBhanki / Ikhadi leMali / iKhadi lokutsalwa, kunye neKhadi leTyala. Unokongeza ezinye iiakhawunti, uzinike ngokutsha, uzinike i-icon, okanye ufihle enye ongasayisebenzisiyo.

Kwi-akhawunti yemali, i-App ibonisa into ebikhona ukuya kuthi ga ekupheleni kwenyanga ephelileyo, umvuzo kunye neendleko zale nyanga, kunye nentsalela efunyenweyo. Kwikhadi lokuthenga ngetyala libonisa oko kubizwe kuyo kunye nento ehlawulwe kuyo kule nyanga, kwaye ibhalansi yayo ifundeka njengenani elibi ngalo lonke ixesha elityalayo.

Ibhalansi ibalwa ukusuka kwibhalansi yakho yokuqala kunye nayo yonke into oyirekhodileyo ukusukela oko. I-App ayikhe iqhagamshelane nebhanki yakho ukubajonga.
terms.guide35Body:
Isikrini seTransaction sidwelisa umvuzo wakho okanye iindleko zosuku olukhethiweyo, inyanga okanye unyaka. Umqolo weetshiphusi ikuvumela ukuba ucuthe uluhlu kwiakhawunti enye, kwaye itotali yaloo mbono ihluziweyo iboniswe ecaleni.

Isishwankathelo esisezipilini eziphezulu zeKhaya: Iindleko, uMvuzo kunye neMali eseleyo kwiakhawunti yakho yemali, noko kubizwe kumakhadi akho okuthenga ngetyala kunye noko kuhlawulwe kuwo kuluhlu lwawo olungezantsi.

Useto lwe-App lukwabonelela ngokujonga zonke iintengiselwano, apho unokuhluza khona ixesha, khetha imigca emininzi ngaxeshanye, kwaye uyicime kunye.
terms.guide36Body:
Kwi-Android i-App inokufunda imiyalezo yebhanki esele ikwi-inbox yakho kwaye iyiguqule ibe yidrafti yentengiselwano. Icela imvume yeSMS kuqala, kwaye unokwala. Imiyalezo ifundwa kwisixhobo sakho kwaye ayilayishwa naphi na.

Ijonga ifestile yamva nje yemiyalezo, isebenze isixa-mali, umhla, umrhwebi, nokuba ibiyimali ngaphakathi okanye ngaphandle, kwaye yeyiphi iakhawunti okanye ikhadi elisetyenzisiweyo, emva koko iqikelela udidi olusuka kwigama lomrhwebi. Imiyalezo engeyiyo intengiselwano, efana namagama ayimfihlo exesha elinye, iintlawulo ezingaphumeleliyo, iziteyitimenti, izaziso zomhla omiselweyo kunye nemali-mboleko okanye unikezelo lomlinganiselo wetyala, ziyahluzwa.

Imali ekhutshwa kwi-ATM iyatsitywa ngabom. Ibhalansi yakho yebhanki kunye nemali esesandleni sakho zihlala kwiakhawunti enye, ngoko ke ukurhoxiswa akuhambisi nto phakathi kwabo, kwaye into ochitha imali kuyo lingeniso ekufanele ukuba nalo. Ukuzoba imali kwikhadi letyala kukuboleka, ngoko ke loo nto isangeniswa kumazwe angaphandle.

Akukho nto igcinwayo de uqinisekise. Ungakhetha okanye ucime yonke into, ucofe imiqolo eyahlukeneyo, kwaye utshintshe udidi phambi kokuthatha ngaphandle. Imiqolo osele uyingenisile iyakhunjulwa kwaye ayizukufakwa kabini.

Apho i-SMS ingafumanekiyo unokuncamathisela umbhalo womyalezo endaweni yoko. Amangeniso asuka kumazwe angaphandle achanekile kuphela njengemiyalezo asuka kuyo, kwaye unoxanduva lokuwajonga.
terms.guide37Body: Iintengiselwano zihlelwe ngokweendidi ezifana neZitya, Ukutya, ezoThutho, iRente, i-EMI, amatyala kunye noMvuzo. Unokongeza eyakho ngophawu olukhethiweyo kunye nombala, uyithiye ngokutsha okanye ucime ezo wongezileyo, kwaye ulusete ngokutsha uludwe lubuyele kokungagqibekanga. Udidi lweZinye alunakususwa, ngoko ke akukho nto isala ngaphandle kwekhaya.
terms.guide38Body: Unokumisela umda wenyanga kulo naliphi na icandelo leendleko kwaye ujonge oko ukuchithileyo ngokuchasene nalo, kuquka ukukhuphela imida yenyanga ephelileyo kweli. Uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali sisikhokelo sakho; iApp ayikuthinteli inkcitho okanye ikuyekise ukurekhoda intengiselwano ehamba ngaphezulu kwenye.
terms.guide39Body:
Iitshathi zibonisa apho imali yakho iye khona njengokwahlulwa kwecandelo, kunye neendlela zokuchitha kunye nothelekiso lwenyanga nenyanga. IKhalenda ibonisa usuku ngalunye lwenyanga kunye neetotali zalo, kwaye ucofe uluhlu lolo suku.

I-Smart Insights ifunda eyakho idatha erekhodiweyo kwisixhobo sakho kwaye yalatha izinto ezifana nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali okufutshane ukuba uluphumelele, udidi oluye lwatsiba xa luthelekiswa nenyanga ephelileyo, okanye inyanga kungekho ngeniso irekhodiweyo. Ulwazi luqwalaselo malunga nento oyifakileyo, hayi ingcebiso, kwaye luphawu lweNtlawulo.
terms.guide310Body: Incwadi yemali yisethi eyahlukileyo yee-akhawunti, ukuthengiselana kunye nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali, ngoko unako ukugcina, umzekelo, iirekhodi zekhaya kunye nezoshishino ngaphandle. Uqala ngenye ebizwa ngokuba yeyoBuntu, kwaye unokwenza ngakumbi, uyithiye ngokutsha, utshintshe i-icon yabo, ugcine ezo ugqibe ngazo, okanye uzicime. Yincwadi oyivulileyo kuphela eboniswa naphi na kwi-App.
terms.guide311Body:
Indawo yokusebenza yeZikhumbuzi ibandakanya amatyala aqhubekayo, amayeza anedosi yasekuseni, emva kwemini nangokuhlwa, igrosari esondela kumhla wokuphelelwa, kunye nezikhumbuzo eziqhelekileyo. Unokuseta ukuba ulumkisiwe kangakanani na, ixesha lokufika kwesilumkiso semihla ngemihla, kwaye i-alam ikhala ixesha elingakanani, kwaye unokuvavanya i-alam nangaliphi na ixesha.

Izikhumbuzo ziluncedo kuphela. Ukuba umntu uyafikelela kuwe kuxhomekeke kuseto lwesixhobo sakho, iimvume, imeko yebhetri kunye nemida yenkqubo yokusebenza, ngoko ke nceda ungathembeli kubo ngayo nayiphi na into ebalulekileyo.
terms.guide312Body:
Indawo yokusebenzela yokuThengisa igcina uluhlu olulula lwezinto ezinobungakanani onokuthi ukhangele kwaye uphawule njengoko uthenge.

Indawo yokusebenza ye-Slit ikuvumela ukuba wabelane ngeendleko nabahlobo kunye namaqela, wahlule isixa-mali ngokulinganayo, ngezixa kanye, ngepesenti, ngezabelo okanye ngohlengahlengiso, kwaye ugcine ingxelo yokuba ngubani otyala ntoni. Ifuna i-akhawunti ongene kuyo kwaye iluphawu lweNtlawulo. I-App igcina irekhodi kuphela; ayishukumisi imali phakathi kwakho nabani na.
terms.guide313Body: Ukukhangela kwiheda kujongwe kwiintengiselwano zakho, izikhumbuzo, izinto zokuthenga kunye nesetingi. Ungatshintsha imali ebonisiweyo kwi-header chip, etshintsha indlela amanani aboniswa ngayo kwaye ayiwaguquleli. IApp ifumaneka ngeelwimi ezininzi. Esi sikhokelo siguqulelwe kwakhona, ngelixa amacandelo asemthethweni eMiqathango yokuSebenzisa anikwe ngesiNgesi.
terms.guide314Body: Ungayitshintsha inkangeleko ye-App enemixholo kwaye unike iprofayile yakho i-avatar yomlinganiswa. Umxholo wasimahla uhlala ufumaneka, kwaye okuseleyo kunokuvulwa ngePremium okanye kuqeshwe ngedayimane.
terms.guide315Body:
Iidayimani ngumvuzo ongaphakathi kwi-app ongenaxabiso lemali. Azinakuthengwa, zithengiswe, zitshintshelwe okanye zitshintshwe ngemali, kwaye azibuyiswa.

Uzizuza ngokukhetha ukubukela intengiso enemivuzo kude kube sekupheleni, nangokumema abahlobo. Kukho umda wokuba zingaphi onokuzifumana kwiintengiso ngosuku ngalunye. Ibhalansi yakho kunye nomda wemihla ngemihla ubanjiwe kwaye ujongiwe kwiseva yethu usebenzisa ixesha leseva, ke ukutshintsha iwotshi yesixhobo sakho akuyi kukwandisa oko unokukufumana.

Ungachitha iidayimani kwiPrimiyamu yokupasa ethatha inani elithile leentsuku, okanye kwizinto ezongezelelweyo ezifana ne-avatar, umxholo, okanye i-Smart Insights okwethutyana. Ukudlula okanye ukuvula okuthengwe ngedayimani kukunika uphawu lwexesha elixeliweyo kuphela, emva koko luphele. Amaxabiso, umvuzo wentengiso nganye kunye nomda wemihla ngemihla ubonisiwe kwi-App kwaye unokutshintsha nangaliphi na ixesha.

Ukupasa kwePremium efunyenwe ngedayimani kuvula iimpawu kodwa ayisusi iintengiso. Kuphela iNtlawulo yaNyanga le ihlawulwayo engenazibhengezo.
terms.guide316Body:
Iakhawunti nganye ongene kuyo ifumana ikhowudi yesimemo. Ukuba umhlobo ufaka ikhowudi yakho, nobabini nifumana iidayimani, ngokuxhomekeke kumda wokuba zingaphi izimemo ezivuzwayo.

Ikhowudi inokusetyenziswa kube kanye umntu ngamnye, awukwazi ukusebenzisa eyakho, kwaye sinokubamba imbuyekezo apho sikholelwa ukuba iikhowudi ziyaxhatshazwa, umzekelo ngeakhawunti ephindwe kabini okanye ezenzekelayo.
terms.guide317Body:
Ukusetyenziswa simahla kugcina iirekhodi zakho kwisixhobo sakho, kubonisa iintengiso, kwaye kushiye ezinye iimpawu zitshixiwe. Kwaye kuvula izinto ozikhethayo, kwaye iPremium ivula yonke into, isuse iintengiso, kwaye yenza ungqamaniso lwamafu.

Intlawulo yenziwa ngesandla yi-UPI, emva koko usithumelele ireferensi yentlawulo kwaye sivula iakhawunti yakho. Ukuqalisa akuko ngoko nangoko. Amaxabiso, imixholo yesicwangciso kunye namaxesha okuhlawula abonisiwe kwi-App kwaye anokutshintsha; utshintsho aluchaphazeli ixesha osele ulihlawulele.
terms.guide318Body:
Abasebenzisi basimahla banokubona ibhena kunye neentengiso zemveli kwiindawo ze-App, kwaye banokukhetha ukubukela iintengiso zevidiyo ezivuzayo ukuze bafumane idayimani. Ukubukela intengiso enemivuzo kusoloko kukhetho lwakho kwaye akufuneki ukuba usebenzise uphawu osele unalo.

Iintengiso zinikezelwa liqela lesithathu kwaye zixhomekeke kwimigaqo yazo kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo yabucala. Intlawulo yaNyanga le iyawasusa.
terms.guide319Body:
NgePremium kunye neakhawunti esayiniweyo, iincwadi zakho ezinkozo, intengiselwano, uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, izikhumbuzo, iindidi kunye nemifanekiso yebhili encanyathiselweyo inokuvumelanisa ukuze ukwazi ukuthatha kwesinye isixhobo. Ungqamaniso lufuna uqhagamshelo olusebenzayo kwaye lunokulibaziseka okanye lungaphelelanga, ngoko ke nceda ungayithathi njengekopi yakho kuphela.

Ugcino lwamafu ngokuqhelekileyo lugcina malunga neminyaka emibini yokugqibela yeerekhodi zomhla. Amangeno amadala ahlala kwisixhobo esiwadalileyo.

Ungangena kuphela kwisixhobo esinye ngexesha; ukungena kwenye indawo kuphelisa iseshoni yangaphambili.
terms.guide320: 3.20 Gcina, ukuthumela ngaphandle kunye nokucima idatha yakho
terms.guide320Body:
IPremium ikuvumela ukuba ugcine ifayile egciniweyo yedatha yakho kwaye uyibuyisele kamva. Ukubuyisela kwakhona kuthatha indawo yento ekhoyo ngoku kwisixhobo, kwaye ukujonga ifayile luxanduva lwakho. Ungakwazi nokuthumela ngaphandle intengiselwano yakho njenge-spreadsheet kuluhlu lomhla olukhethileyo.

Ungayicima idatha yakho nangaliphi na ixesha: ukusuka kwesi sixhobo, kwilifu, okanye zombini. Ukucinywa kusisigxina, ke thatha i-backup kuqala ukuba unokufuna iirekhodi kwakhona.
terms.guide321Body: Ungajonga ngapha nangapha uninzi lweApp ngaphandle kweakhawunti. Ukugcina iirekhodi zakho, ukuthumela imiyalezo ngaphandle, ukufumana okanye ukuchitha iidayimani, kunye nokuvumelanisa zonke zifuna ukuba ungene ngemvume, ongayenza ngeGoogle, iApple okanye idilesi ye-imeyile kunye negama lokugqitha.
terms.guide322Body:
Useto lwe-App lunokhetho lwe-akhawunti ye-Cima. Siyakubuza ukuba kutheni uhamba, kwaye emva kokuba uqinisekise, i-akhawunti iyacinywa ngoko nangoko: uphumile, awukwazi ukungena kwakhona, kwaye yonke into egcinwe kuloo fowuni iyacinywa. Thatha i-backup kuqala ukuba unokufuna iirekhodi.

Isicelo ke siya kumlawuli, osusa iakhawunti kunye nekopi yayo yelifu kwiirekhodi zethu. De kube oko kwenzeka i-akhawunti ihlala icinyiwe kwaye ingasebenziseki. Ukuba uvale ngempazamo, bhala ukuxhasa ngokukhawuleza kwaye kunokwenzeka ukuba uyibuyisele.

Iindleko owabelane ngazo kwi-Split hlala nabahlobo owabelane nabo, ngoko ke ibhalansi yabo isayongeza. Isizathu osinike sona sigcinwa ngaphandle kwegama lakho, njengestatistiki.

help.balanceBody:
Umvuzo weKhaya, iiNdleko, kunye neMali eseleyo yeyenyanga ekhethiweyo kuphela (umvuzo - iindleko zaloo nyanga).

Ayiyiyo yonke i-wallet yakho epheleleyo. Iibhalansi zeakhawunti zihlala phantsi kweeAkhawunti.
help.accountsBody:
Imali kunye neBhanki zibambe imali yakho. Imali ekhoyo yinto esele ikhona ngaphandle komvuzo wale nyanga. Ingeniso yenyanga yangoku yongezwa ukusuka eKhaya → Ingeniso (efunyenwe ngaphakathi).

Sebenzisa Ihlawulwe nge / ifunyenwe ukuze intengiselwano nganye ibethe iakhawunti elungileyo. Amagama eakhawunti aphindwe kabini adityaniswa abe nye.
help.monthlyBody: Kwikhadi leakhawunti ngalinye, vula ibhalansi yeNyanga ukuze ubone iimali kude kube sekupheleni kwenyanga nganye (umzekelo ukuya kutsho ngoMeyi, ukuya kuJuni). Inani elikhulu elisekhadini yitotali yakho eyongezelekayo namhlanje.
help.buyListBody: Yongeza izinto oceba ukuzithenga. Evenkileni, phawula into nganye njengoko uyikhethile. Uluhlu lokuthenga aluzithumeli izinto kwizeMali okanye kwizikhumbuzi zegrosari.
help.remindersBody: Sebenzisa Izikhumbuzi ngamatyala, amayeza, ukuphelelwa kwegrosari, kunye namanqaku aqhelekileyo. Iialamu zixhomekeke kwiimvume zefowuni yakho kunye noseto lwamandla.
help.premiumBody:
Iprimiyamu ivula ezongezelelekileyo njengemixholo, ii-avatar zabalinganiswa, ii-Smart Insights, ugcino lwefayile/ukubuyisela, kunye nongqamaniso lwamafu.

Isimahla igcina idatha ikakhulu kule fowuni kwaye ingabonisa iintengiso.

Iiakhawunti zolawulo zibandakanya iPremium kwaye zikhutshiwe kwimida yokugcina ilifu echazwe phantsi kongqamaniso lwamafu.
help.cloudBody:
Ungqamaniso lwamafu luphawu lwePrimiyamu. Ngelixa iPremium isebenza, ilifu ligcina malunga neminyaka emibini yokugqibela yedatha yezemali (intengiselwano, uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, imifanekiso yebhili enxulumeneyo). Izikhumbuzo kunye noluhlu lokuthenga luhlala kulo lonke ixesha leNtlawulo yaNyanga le.

Sisixhobo esinye kuphela esinokuhlala singena ngexesha.

Ukuba iPremium iyaphela, idatha yelifu ibanjwa kangangeenyanga ezi-3 zexesha lobabalo kungekho lungqamaniso lungaphaya. Ukuba uhlaziya kula festile, ungqamaniso luqalisa kwakhona. Ukuba awuhlaziyi, yonke idatha yefu yeakhawunti yakho iyacinywa kwaye uyaqhubeka njengomsebenzisi wasimahla. Idata kule fowuni ayicinywanga yile cloud yosula.

Abalawuli bakhululiwe kwi-2-year prune kunye ne-post-grace cloud wipe.
help.backupBody:
Ugcino / Buyisela (i-Premium) wabelane okanye ungenise ifayile ye-JSON.

Ukuthunyelwa ngaphandle kubandakanya umfanekiso wedatha yakho kunye nedatha ekhethiweyoQala / idathaImihla yokuphela kwentengiselwano yakho.

Ukungeniswa ngaphandle akusuli yonke into. Ihlaziya iintengiselwano kunye nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwecandelo kuphela kuluhlu lomhla kwifayile; idatha ngaphandle koluhlu kule fowuni ihlala. Iiakhawunti zithathwa kwifayile kuphela ukuba le fowuni ayinayo intengiselwano okwangoku (umzekelo emva kokubuyisela kwakhona); kungenjalo iiakhawunti zakho zangoku zihlala. Uya kucelwa ukuba utshintshe izikhumbuzo kunye noluhlu lokuthenga.

Ukuba ungqamaniso lwamafu ePrimiyamu luvuliwe, iziphumo ezidityanisiweyo zingqamanisa kwilifu (esengaphakathi kwe-~2 yeminyaka yefestile yelifu).

Iifayile ze-JSON ozigcina kwiiFayile, iDrayivu, okanye i-imeyile zihlala ziphantsi kolawulo lwakho kwaye azicinywa xa idatha yelifu icocwa.

Coca i-cache isusa kuphela iifayile zexeshana zokuthumela ngaphandle - ayicimi utshintshiselwano okanye useto lwakho.
